title: IMPL: [ctop] Topological Context Pruning for Token Savings
description:
WHAT: Port ctop's topological analysis logic to prune irrelevant component context before sending prompts to the LLM.

WHY: To reduce LLM token usage by up to 80% by only sending the 'impact radius' of a change.

HOW:
1. Implement a component tree parser in crates/craftegy-design-core.
2. Use ctop-inspired graph algorithms to select the Minimum Sufficient Context (MSC).
3. Integrate MSC selection into the prompt assembly pipeline.

AC:
- [ ] Context pruning logic identifies minimal component sub-graphs.
- [ ] Prompt size is measurably reduced compared to full context.
